description: This file defines the 'Interface' for interacting with etcd in a Kubernetes context, including methods for get, list, count, put, and delete operations, along with related option and response types.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a single key-value pair from etcd with optional revision.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves key-value pairs with a specific prefix, supporting pagination and revision options.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of keys with a given prefix.

methods.name: OptimisticPut
methods.description: Creates or updates a key-value pair if it hasn't been modified since a specified revision.

methods.name: OptimisticDelete
methods.description: Deletes a key-value pair if it hasn't been modified since a specified revision.
